description: This file defines the GatewayHealthMonitor class responsible for performing periodic health checks of a gateway component. It manages asynchronous tasks, handles timeouts, and triggers failure handling logic based on check results.

classes.name: GatewayHealthMonitor
classes.description: A class that periodically checks the health of a gateway using configurable parameters for interval, timeout, and failure thresholds. Manages asynchronous tasks and handles failures.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a GatewayHealthMonitor instance with optional configuration and sleep handler.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the health monitoring task, executing periodic health checks and invoking a failure handler upon repeated failures.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing health check task.

methods.name: runCheck
methods.description: Executes a health check with an optional timeout, returning true if successful, false otherwise.
